summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K announcing a routine daily share buyback transaction. The company purchased 500,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International on 31 July 2026 at a volume-weighted average price of 115.5592 pence per share, part of an existing buyback programme announced 30 January 2026 to repurchase up to £1.75 billion. Shares will be cancelled. To date, 1,313,502,808 shares have been purchased for £1,306,727,163.43. Reporting frequency will change to weekly from 3 August 2026 per FCA rule amendments. Watch: continued execution against remaining buyback authorization.
